native probe source changes during execution stay stale despite complete observed controls

native probe output overrun counts delivered stdout and stderr and stops every later case

native run budgets retain partial cancelled bytes and spend one wall allowance across fresh cases

native probe preparation that spends the wall allowance cannot start a project process

native probe retains malformed binary stdout stderr and output overruns without crediting a claim
native probe cancellation retains the reached attempt and never creates evidence for later cases
review scoring separates actionable correctness proper probability losses reliability and risk from complete selected-case accounting
scoring retains unresolved findings missing probabilities endpoint infinite loss and absence of any review without reporting a clean cohort
one-sided exact binomial limits need sufficient independent evidence and repeated clusters cannot inherit a finding-level interval
scoring rejects empty or duplicate assignments out-of-cohort observations contradictory terminal labels and unfrozen thresholds
retained scoring projections reconstruct every numerator denominator family bin and confidence bound and hide trial identifiers
review scoring CLI and MCP return the shared truthful report without inference source grants or project execution

initialDiagnostics.reason: The selected baseline files ran extra callbacks; all-pass count was incorrectly compared to required-case count. The final controller verifies every required ledger case and the complete selected run.
The test subprocess inherited NODE_TEST_CONTEXT, so Node refused recursive test execution. The final external acceptance subprocess removes that marker and all nine installed callbacks actually run.

An owned temporary namespace inside the ESM repository made extensionless CommonJS Git wrappers inherit module scope. A paired executable reproduction verified this; final runs use separate task-owned directories outside the package tree.
